title: Remote Action Authorization Receipt v1
description: Generic, durable, schema-governed authorization receipt for external remote actions. Binds authorization to a specific request digest, action class, provider, target identity, expected prior remote evidence, and single-use semantics. Suitable for GitHub user profiles, repository creation, issue mutations, Actions mutations, Pages configuration, and later comparable provider actions. Lane A owns this generic authority substrate; Lane B consumes it for GitHub-specific remote mutation authorization.

authorization_id.description: Stable authorization identifier — used as the persistent file key.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of receipt creation.

action_class.description: Remote action class. Additional provider actions may be added by the owning authority.

target_identity.description: Bounded target identity (repository name, user login, issue number, workflow ID).

requested_actor.description: Identity of the requesting actor under existing conventions.

producer_identity.description: Identity of the evidence or authorization producer.

request_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the canonical proposed request payload. Binds authorization to the exact request — a different payload must not be authorized.

prior_evidence_digest.description: SHA256 digest of the remote evidence the request was planned against. Empty for creation actions. Freshness-required actions refuse on mismatch.

permission_scope_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the granted permission scope.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the receipt is invalid.

one_time.description: True for single-use receipts, False for bounded-use.

max_uses.description: Maximum uses for bounded-use receipts (ignored when one_time=True).

use_count.description: Current use count for bounded-use receipts.

consumed.description: True when a one-time receipt has been consumed.

receipt_sha256.description: Integrity digest covering all receipt data (excluding this field).
